character.name: Idle
character.prompt: An eerie wooden slit-drum creature (Tung Tung Tung Sahur), side view idle animation. Tall cylindrical smooth light-brown wooden log body, carved human-like facial features with unnervingly large bulging round eyes, straight nose, and a wide unsettling carved smile. Extremely thin stick-like spindly arms and legs, disproportionately massive elongated bare human feet planted flat on the floor. Right hand loosely holding a smooth wooden club bat pointed downward. Subtle creepy swaying idle motion, log torso slightly rocking side to side while maintaining the unblinking wide-eyed stare. Clean bold outline, limited palette, chibi 3-head proportions.
